scope: Primary TCM-MKG benchmark and KTKP; existing DragonTCM findings retained as exploratory domain-shift evidence
status: Locally fixed extension protocol, not public preregistration. Historical primary and KTKP split 20261022 test results have already been inspected.

search.role: Dev-only sensitivity audit, supplementary to fixed-configuration replication
search.selection: Highest development filtered MRR; ties prefer the existing 0.003 default. Selected configurations are frozen in a separate file before test evaluation.
search.sensitivity_selection: One-factor-at-a-time development analysis only; does not change locked main settings

evaluation.boundary: All-entity ranking with typed-negative-trained models, separate diagnostic, not all-entity-trained superiority
evaluation.uncertainty: 5000 formula-cluster bootstrap draws on seed-averaged query differences for MRR and Hits@1; seed sample SD reported separately

integrity: All methods use identical retained queries
No pharmacological or clinical causality claim
